import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 36
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
G = 64


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.film = nn.Linear(G, 2 * WIDTH)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(G, G), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(G, 1))

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c3(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        a, b = self.film(g).chunk(2, dim=1)
        h = f * (2.0 * torch.sigmoid(a))[:, :, None, None] + b[:, :, None, None]
        place = self.head(h)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
LC = 32
PROJ = 16
HID = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.lin = nn.Conv2d(12, LC, 1)
        self.tproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, LC, 1)
        self.lmix = nn.Conv2d(LC, LC, 1)
        self.hproj = nn.Conv2d(LC, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

        build = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        miss = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        extra = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        b_below = F.pad(build[:, :Z - 1], (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))
        t_below = F.pad(tgt[:, :Z - 1], (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))
        b_above = F.pad(build[:, 1:], (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
        t_above = F.pad(tgt[:, 1:], (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
        per = torch.stack([build, tgt, miss, extra, b_below, t_below, b_above, t_above], dim=2)
        gch = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zi = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        li = torch.cat([per, gch, zi], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 12, Y, X)

        t = self.tproj(f).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, LC, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, LC, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.lin(li) + t)
        h = F.relu(h + self.lmix(h))
        p = self.hproj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            hh = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(hh))
        sc = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        T = sc.shape[1]
        sc = sc.view(B, Z, T, Y, X)
        place = torch.logsumexp(sc, dim=1).flatten(1)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 512, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "lr": 0.0007}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
D = 48
HEADS = 4
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.heads = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, 2 * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(2 * d, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, Dm = x.shape
        H = self.heads
        dh = Dm // H
        qkv = self.qkv(self.ln1(x)).view(B, N, 3, H, dh).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
        att = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(dh), dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(att, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, Dm)
        x = x + self.proj(o)
        x = x + self.ff2(F.relu(self.ff1(self.ln2(x))))
        return x


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y, X = int(spec.Y), int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, D, 3, padding=1)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, D, Y, X) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS), Block(D, HEADS)])
        self.lnf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        t = (x + self.pos).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            t = blk(t)
        t = self.lnf(t).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        f = F.relu(x + t)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        self.lmix = nn.Conv2d(LC, LC, 1)
        self.hproj = nn.Conv2d(LC, PROJ, 1)
        self.mproj = nn.Conv2d(self.T, HID, 1)

        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())

        Z = self.Z
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

        build = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        miss = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        extra = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        b_below = F.pad(build[:, :Z - 1], (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))
        t_below = F.pad(tgt[:, :Z - 1], (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))
        b_above = F.pad(build[:, 1:], (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
        t_above = F.pad(tgt[:, 1:], (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
        per = torch.stack([build, tgt, miss, extra, b_below, t_below, b_above, t_above], dim=2)
        gch = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zi = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        li = torch.cat([per, gch, zi], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 12, Y, X)

        a = self.lin(li)
        c = F.relu(a.view(B, Z, LC, Y, X)[:, :, :ZC])
        up = torch.cummax(c, dim=1).values
        dn = torch.flip(torch.cummax(torch.flip(c, [1]), dim=1).values, [1])
        zc = torch.cat([up, dn], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 2 * ZC, Y, X)

        t = self.tproj(f).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, LC, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, LC, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(a + self.zmix(zc) + t)
        h = F.relu(h + self.lmix(h))
        p = self.hproj(h)

        mm = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        mf = self.mproj(mm).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, HID, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, HID, Y, X)

            o = out(hh).view(B, Z, 2, Y, X)
            sc = o[:, :, 0] + F.log_softmax(o[:, :, 1], dim=1)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(sc, dim=1))
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))

        self.lmix = nn.Conv2d(LC, LC, 1)
        self.hproj = nn.Conv2d(LC, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

        build = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        miss = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        extra = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        b_below = F.pad(build[:, :Z - 1], (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))
        t_below = F.pad(tgt[:, :Z - 1], (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))
        b_above = F.pad(build[:, 1:], (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
        t_above = F.pad(tgt[:, 1:], (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
        per = torch.stack([build, tgt, miss, extra, b_below, t_below, b_above, t_above], dim=2)
        gch = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zi = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        li = torch.cat([per, gch, zi], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 12, Y, X)

        a = self.lin(li)
        c = F.relu(a.view(B, Z, LC, Y, X)[:, :, :ZC])
        up = torch.cummax(c, dim=1).values
        dn = torch.flip(torch.cummax(torch.flip(c, [1]), dim=1).values, [1])
        zc = torch.cat([up, dn], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 2 * ZC, Y, X)

        t = self.tproj(f).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, LC, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, LC, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(a + self.zmix(zc) + t)
        h = F.relu(h + self.lmix(h))
        p = self.hproj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            hh = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            o = out(hh).view(B, Z, 2, Y, X)
            sc = o[:, :, 0] + F.log_softmax(o[:, :, 1], dim=1)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(sc, dim=1))
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no results yet, and scores stay hidden, so each trial is a separate bet. Only crashes and timeouts will be visible. The main constraint is the budget. The default recipe gets about 131k steps, which is only 32 PPO updates, and a bigger network gets fewer samples. So I'll keep the compute ratio r close to 1 and spend effort on the recipe and on structure. The starting design already suits the task. Whether a placement is correct depends on the landing layer (the highest build cell under the footprint) and on the next missing target cell in each covered column. That is local, so per-column 1x1 features plus max/min pooling over the footprint is a good fit. Two things look under-served. First, credit for the +1 exact-build bonus with gamma 0.95, since one wrong order early can ruin the whole build. Second, the small number of policy updates. This round tests two recipes on the starting net and one modest structural change (a wider receptive field and global conditioning) at about r≈1.1.
analyses.2: No scores are shown. All we know is that the three round-1 trials trained without errors at r of about 1.0 to 1.2, and all three used gamma 0.99. The starting net may struggle with one thing: a placement is right only if the layer it lands on matches the target. Here that layer is the maximum column height under the brick's footprint, and the starting net's 2D trunk mixes all layers together before the head. I propose a 2x2 grid that crosses two factors. The first factor is the head: the existing footprint-pooling head, or a new head that scores each layer separately and pools over layers with a learned logsumexp. The second factor is the recipe: 2 PPO epochs (as in r1c1), or 1 epoch with 512 envs, which gives about 3.3x fresh designs for the same compute and about the same number of gradient steps. Fresh designs should help the agent generalise to held-out targets. Seed noise is large, so the 2x2 grid gives more robust information than four separate changes.
analyses.3: All six trials trained without errors, but no scores are shown, so I can't tell which helped. Placement order depends on more than the layer where a brick lands. The cells it seals below that layer must also be empty in the target, and for an overhang the cells underneath must stay empty until the brick is placed. The layer-aware head (r2c1, r2c3) can only see one layer up or down. It also merges the layers with a plain logsumexp, which leaves the network to learn on its own which layer the brick actually lands on. Two ideas are untested. One is to apply cumulative max along z after a learned layer, so the head can see any depth. The other is to add a learned gate that picks the landing layer. I propose these with both recipes, because I can't tell whether 1 or 2 epochs works better. I also try a new idea, global self-attention over cells, for long-range support and DONE decisions.
analyses.4: No scores are visible, so I can only choose from priors and from which trials trained cleanly. All 9 trials trained without errors. The layer-aware landing head is the idea that best matches the task: whether a placement is right depends on which layer the brick lands in and whether that layer is missing cells there. Its latest version, r3c1, adds z-cumulative features and a landing gate. It uses about 1.5x the starting compute and trains for 278k steps, well inside the time and compute limits. Recipes that see more fresh designs (1 epoch, 512 envs) give 2–3x more samples. That should help generalisation to unseen designs. In this final round I refine r3c1 in three ways, one main change each: (1) the legal-action mask as a learned input to the head, (2) cheap per-layer spatial context from a depthwise 3x3 conv, and (3) a recipe change to 32-step rollouts with lower entropy.
